definition.text: The series of molecular signals mediated by TOR (Target of rapamycin) proteins, members of the phosphoinositide (PI) 3-kinase related kinase (PIKK) family that act as serine/threonine kinases in response to nutrient availability or growth factors.
Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of TOR signaling.
Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of TOR signaling.
Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of TOR signaling.

A protein complex that contains at least TOR (target of rapamycin) in complex with other signaling components. Mediates the phosphorylation and activation of downstream signaling components including PKB (AKT) or S6K.
